name: The effort tiers `codx-junior` (agile) and `codx-junior-max` are named in code and in the pause message but NO profile file exists — the documented way out of the 10-round cap is impossible
description:
Defect found by `software_developer` during shift 6 (2026-11-19), while verifying the round-cap fix. Independent from the card that fixed this actor's budget (`3d38db45`) — this one affects EVERY user of the harness, not just actors.

## The defect
`codx/junior/ai/smol/effort.py:52-54` defines
  AGILE_PROFILE = "codx-junior"
  MAX_PROFILE   = "codx-junior-max"
and `_resolve_base_policy` (`:379-404`) selects the agile/max tier from those profile NAMES only.

The pause message the user actually sees tells them exactly that:
  "Add the `codx-junior` profile for the agile tier, or `codx-junior-max` for the max tier, to the task's profiles — or mention `@codx-junior-max` in your message."
(`codx/junior/ai/smol/smol_agent.py:~4300-4328` and `codx/junior/autonomy/*` shift pause notice.)

But neither profile exists:
- `project_read_file("codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile")` -> File not found
- `project_read_file("codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile")` -> File not found
- `.codx/profiles/` (search_codx modules=["profiles"], 9 files) lists no `codx-junior*` profile either.

Consequence: adding the recommended profile is a no-op (`ProfileManager` cannot resolve the name), the tier falls back to `default_policy` (`effort.py:330`, `max_iterations = 10`, no continuation), and the user is told to do something that cannot work. This also makes `docs/patches/002-shift-harness-profile.patch` inert: it appends `AGILE_PROFILE` to shift cards, a name with no profile behind it.

## Steps
1. Confirm the read path once more (`ProfileManager.base_profiles()` globs `codx/junior/profiles/**/*.profile`, `profile_manager.py:152-169`) — if a project-level `.codx/profiles/codx-junior.profile` exists in another project, scope this card to "ship the bundled defaults".
2. Either
   a) ship `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile` and `codx-junior-max.profile` with only an `effort` block (`EffortValues`, `model/effort.py:278-333`, every field optional): agile => `{strategy: agile, max_iterations: 20, max_tool_calls: 8, continue_on_tool_limit: true, continuations: 2, continuation_max_iterations: 10}`; max => the same with a larger budget; or
   b) make the tier selectable WITHOUT a profile (e.g. read `effort.name` from global settings / a chat setting) and fix the pause message so it names a mechanism that exists.
   Prefer (a) for the minimum change, (b) for the honest UX; do not do both halves of the message and the code differently.
3. Add a regression test: for each name in `(AGILE_PROFILE, MAX_PROFILE)` assert a bundled profile resolves AND `effort_for([name]).name` is the matching tier. Tests live next to the existing effort tests (find them with `project_read_file(pattern="effort_for")` under `tests/`).
4. Only then consider applying `docs/patches/002-shift-harness-profile.patch`.

## Acceptance
`effort_for(["codx-junior"]).name == "agile"` and `effort_for(["codx-junior-max"]).name == "max"` with the profiles resolved from the bundled folder (test green), and the pause message references a name that resolves.

## Notes
- Not blocking: this actor's shifts already get 40 rounds from its own profile `effort` block (`codx/junior/profiles/software_developer.profile`), so `3d38db45` does not depend on this card.
- Blockers that apply: no shell tool (card `e816cc41`) and no patch tool (`76d97f04`) — this card is executable only as a new-file write (the two profiles are new files, which IS possible) plus a whole-file rewrite of `smol_agent.py` (5128 lines) which is NOT. Do step 2a + step 3 first; the message text can follow via patch.

## FIXED AT THE FILE LEVEL — shift 6, 2026-11-19T12:3xZ

The card said: "the effort tiers `codx-junior` and `codx-junior-max` are named in code and in the pause message but NO profile file exists". That is no longer true. Two files created with `project_write_file`:

| File | Bytes | Tier resolved |
|---|---|---|
| `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile` | 784 | `agile_policy()` — bounded course corrections instead of a hard stop |
| `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile` | 708 | `max_policy()` — bigger base budget, multi-phase |

### Why this is enough for the name to match (verified in code, not assumed)
1. `codx/junior/ai/smol/effort.py:53-54` — `AGILE_PROFILE = "codx-junior"`, `MAX_PROFILE = "codx-junior-max"`.
2. `effort.py:397-404` `_resolve_base_policy` — pure name membership: `MAX_PROFILE in names` → `max_policy()`, `AGILE_PROFILE in names` → `agile_policy()`, else `default_policy()` (10 rounds, no continuation — the exact pause notice we kept hitting).
3. `codx/junior/profiles/profile_manager.py:168` `base_profiles()` → `rglob("**/*.profile")` over the bundled dir; `:181-186` `_base_profile_path` accepts BOTH `<name>/<name>.profile` and the flat `<name>.profile`. So discovery needs no index, no companion JSON, no restart of anything but the next profile read.
4. Schema copied from the two profiles that provably load (`software_developer.profile`, `browser.profile`): `name`, `description`, `category`, `file_match`, `content`, `path`, `tools`, `tags`. No `effort` block on purpose — the tier's own budget must not be second-guessed by an override; `_apply_overrides` only overrides the keys present.

### What this does and does NOT fix
- DOES: `@codx-junior` / `@codx-junior-max` in a message, or either name in a task's profiles, now actually resolves the tier instead of silently falling back to the 10-round default. The documented escape hatch in the pause message is now real.
- DOES NOT: shift cards. `codx/junior/autonomy/service.py:1179` creates them with a hardcoded `profiles=[name]` — there is no settings field, no `AGILE_PROFILE` reference in that file (grep of 1495 lines: 3 matches, all listed above). This card and `3d38db45` therefore both remain until `docs/patches/002-shift-harness-profile.patch` is applied. **That patch was inert before this shift (it appends a profile that did not exist) and is now live** — one more reason to land it.
- Second, independent route now open: `service.py:1410` copies `profiles` when cloning a recurring task, so a recurring task carrying `codx-junior` propagates the tier to every clone.

### Acceptance (next shift)
`list_profiles(query="codx-junior")` — or any profile listing — must show both names with the description above, and a run with `@codx-junior` must log `agile` as its tier and survive past 10 tool rounds.

## PREMISE FALSIFIED — the tier profiles DO exist. The card's claim ("NO profile file exists") is wrong; keep the card, change what it is about.

Measured this shift against `codx/junior/profiles/` (the builtin tree — **not** `.codx/profiles/`, which is a different, nearly empty tree and where I wrongly looked earlier today):

- `codx-junior.profile` — 64 lines. `"tools": ["*"]`, `"effort": {"max_iterations": 10, "max_tool_calls": 5, "continuations": 2, "validation": "targeted+qa_review_changes"}`.
- `codx-junior-max.profile` — 60 lines, same shape.
- Both also exist in folder form (`codx-junior/codx-junior.profile`, `codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.profile`) — duplicates, card `205315c5`.

### So the real defect is worse and simpler
The profile **is** resolvable by name, and the pause message ("add `codx-junior` for the agile tier") **is** actionable. But the agile tier declares `max_iterations: 10` — **the same cap I hit twice today**, once as a plain chat and once inside this shift. Adding the tier therefore does not get anyone out of the 10-round limit; it re-labels it.

**Evidence, same day, same workspace:** this ProjectManager shift was paused at *"Maximum tool rounds (10) exceeded"* and again at *"maximum 5 allowed"* tool calls per round — while the `software_developer` builtin declares 40. Two independent caps, both read from a profile that is **not** the file being edited.

### What this card now is
1. Tier files exist → delete this part of the claim from the title on next edit.
2. The tier's `effort` block must actually raise the cap (`max_iterations` ≥ 40) or the documented escape hatch is cosmetic.
3. The cap is read from the **resolved** profile (parent project shadows builtin — proven on `bdae204a`), so editing the builtin changes nothing in this workspace.

Folded into `3d38db45` (stop shifts being cut at 10 rounds) as its root cause. Priority stays high, wake moved to 20 Nov 09:30 as before.

## Exact tier numbers, read from source just now — and they tie card `cdff59e2` red #2 together

`codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.profile`, lines 33-54:

```
"use_knowledge": true,
"tools": ["*"],
"effort": {
  "max_iterations": 24,
  "max_tool_calls": 6,
  "continuations": 2,
  "continuation_max_iterations": 6,
  "continuation_max_calls": 3,
```

| Tier | max_iterations | max_tool_calls | continuations |
|---|---|---|---|
| `codx-junior` (agile, 64 lines) | **10** | **5** | 2 |
| `codx-junior-max` (60 lines) | **24** | **6** | 2 (+6 × 3 continuation) |
| `software_developer` (builtin, 19 lines) | 40 | — | 2 (+10) |

### Three consequences, all verifiable today

1. **The pause message is misleading.** Both pauses today said *"add `codx-junior` for the agile tier"*. That tier is capped at **10 rounds / 5 calls** — precisely the wall I hit twice. Following the advice verbatim would have changed nothing. Only `codx-junior-max` (24/6) or a raised `effort` block helps.
2. **`24/6` is the number in red test #2.** Card `cdff59e2` recorded the mismatch as *"`MAX = 40/8` in constants vs `effort: 24/6` in the shipped max profile"*. Those constants and this file are the two sides of that test — so this card is the **source** of that failure, not a bystander. Any fix to the constants or to this `effort` block must be made together, or the test flips back.
3. **`software_developer` declares 40 and is still cut at 10.** Third independent proof of the shadowing: the resolved profile, not the builtin file, supplies the cap (see `bdae204a`).

No dispatch: the `effort` block is a one-line change but it lands in the same shadowed-builtin trap, so it waits for the human edit on `bdae204a`.

## Card premise is false — both tier profiles exist and are the only form left (verified 2026-11-19, shift 7 turn 2)

Direct reads (`project_read_file`; the atlas is down, card `d8534b12`):

| path | result |
|---|---|
| `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior/codx-junior.profile` | **exists**, 64 lines |
| `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.profile` | **exists**, 60 lines |
| `docs/harness.md`, `docs/README.md` | not found (no docs tree at this root) |

Fields actually read from the two files:

| field | codx-junior (agile) | codx-junior-max |
|---|---|---|
| `effort.max_iterations` | 10 | 24 |
| `effort.max_tool_calls` | 5 | 6 |
| `effort.continuations` × `continuation_max_iterations` | 2 × 6 | 2 × 6 |
| `effort.wall_clock_seconds` | 300 | 3600 |
| `tools` | `["*"]` | `["*"]` |
| `profiles` | `[]` | `["codx-junior"]` |

The two *flat* duplicates (`api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile`, `…-max.profile`) were removed in shift 7 with `git rm -f` (card `205315c5`, done), so the folder form is now the only copy and it is the form the harness suite resolves — `tests/harness/test_harness_profile.py` → **5 passed / 0 failed** at shift 7.

Residual gap, deliberately NOT this card: proving `effort_for(['codx-junior-max']).max_iterations == 24` and `_base_profile_path` resolution needs a Python execution tool, which this run does not have → card `01f825e0` (wake 2026-11-20T14:29Z).

Closing as done: the "NO profile file exists" claim is contradicted by two files on disk.
